purpose: Build an outcome-independent external panel for testing whether short-lived reproductive-state information predicts later local demographic redistribution across Pygoscelis colony systems.

discovery_system.reason: Palmer generated the hypothesis and has already been extensively analyzed.

repositories: institutional repositories linked from primary papers
public GitHub repositories linked from peer-reviewed studies
query_families: Pygoscelis colony breeding success population count data
Adelie penguin subcolony breeding pairs chicks dataset
chinstrap penguin colony breeding success time series data
gentoo penguin colony breeding success time series data
penguin colony productivity population monitoring dataset
Pygoscelis breeding pairs fledged chicks colony year
Adelie colony growth breeding success data repository
search_scope.screening_rule: Record every plausible candidate returned by the fixed query families before inspecting response direction. Do not retain or drop a candidate based on observed performance-growth association.

allowed: missingness summaries that do not expose outcome direction
whether adult abundance and reproductive performance can be aligned by unit and breeding season
prohibited: correlations between reproductive performance and later growth
plots pairing performance with future abundance
selecting subsets based on favorable effect direction

dataset_eligibility.local_unit: Stable colony/subcolony/local breeding-group identifier used repeatedly across years. Whole-population annual totals alone are not eligible for the external redistribution panel.
dataset_eligibility.abundance: Numeric breeding-pair, occupied-nest, or breeding-adult count for the local unit in repeated breeding seasons.
dataset_eligibility.performance: Numeric reproductive-performance quantity at the same local unit and season, derivable without using future abundance. Allowed examples include chicks fledged, chicks reaching creche, chicks per breeding pair, or monitored-nest success.

temporal.adjacency: Must permit at least some t, t+1 and t+2 annual alignments; no interpolation across missing years.

dataset_eligibility.provenance: Raw or author-processed values must be publicly retrievable with a stable source and deterministic local-unit identity. Figure digitization is not eligible.
dataset_eligibility.aggregation: No new manual merging or splitting of local units. Inherit author-defined stable unit identities.
dataset_eligibility.independence: A dataset is counted as a distinct system only if it represents a distinct monitored breeding population/site or non-overlapping monitoring program. Multiple publications of the same underlying time series count once.

screening_decisions.ELIGIBLE: All metadata criteria met and raw/processed table accessible.
screening_decisions.ACCESS_BLOCKED: Metadata criteria appear met but raw values cannot currently be retrieved.
screening_decisions.INELIGIBLE_AGGREGATE_ONLY: Only site/population totals are available with no repeated local units.
screening_decisions.INELIGIBLE_NO_PERFORMANCE: Repeated local abundance exists but no alignable reproductive-performance endpoint.
screening_decisions.INELIGIBLE_NO_ABUNDANCE: Performance exists but no repeated local adult abundance.
screening_decisions.INELIGIBLE_UNSTABLE_UNIT: Local unit identity cannot be linked deterministically through time.

stage_A_output.required: A candidate ledger containing source, species, site, metadata evidence, decision and reason for every screened candidate.
stage_A_output.panel_lock: Outcome analysis may begin only after the complete candidate ledger for all fixed query families is committed.
stage_A_output.no_minimum_dataset_rescue: Do not relax eligibility thresholds if fewer systems qualify.

universal_primary_endpoint.reason: Use the same denominator-separated timing for every performance metric, even when a local performance measure does not share the adult-count denominator.
universal_primary_endpoint.performance_state: Within each site/region x predictor season, z-standardize local-unit reproductive performance across eligible units.
universal_primary_endpoint.outcome: relative_growth_i,t+1 = log1p(N_i,t+2) - log1p(N_i,t+1), demeaned within the corresponding site/region x outcome transition.
universal_primary_endpoint.model: relative_growth_i,t+1 ~ beta_system * performance_state_i,t + z_prior_size_i,t+1 + local_unit fixed effect

null.permutation: Within each predictor site/region x season, permute performance states among all eligible local units while preserving future missingness, outcome, prior size and local-unit identity.
null.seed_rule: 20261010 plus deterministic integer index of the locked system ledger
null.p_value: one-sided upper-tail Monte Carlo p with +1 correction

secondary: same-interval performance -> t to t+1 growth, descriptive only because some datasets share the adult-count denominator
performance -> t+2 to t+3 growth where information permits
source-defined island/sector sensitivity only if that grouping is present before outcome analysis

cross_system_generality.if_fewer_than_three: Report system-specific results only; no cross-system generality test or universal claim.

combined_test_if_at_least_three.method: weighted signed Stouffer combination of each system's one-sided permutation p-value
combined_test_if_at_least_three.system_z: Phi^-1(1 - p_i); p_i > 0.5 contributes a negative z
combined_test_if_at_least_three.support_rule: combined_p <= 0.05 AND at least two thirds of eligible systems have beta_system > 0

cross_system_generality.leave_one_system_out: If >=4 systems qualify, report combined inference after removing each system; descriptive robustness only.

interpretation.supported: Short-lived reproductive-state information predicts later local demographic redistribution across multiple independent Pygoscelis systems.
interpretation.not_supported: Do not generalize the Palmer history-dependent pattern beyond the systems that individually support it.
interpretation.mechanism_boundary: Even cross-system generality would not identify public information, retention, prospecting, predation or persistent environment as the causal carrier.

anti_cherry_pick_rules: Do not add new search terms after learning candidate effect directions.
Do not exclude a qualifying system because its coefficient is null or negative.
Do not lower year, row or local-unit thresholds to increase the number of positive systems.
Do not switch the primary lag by dataset.
Do not replace the universal denominator-separated endpoint with a more favorable same-year or one-interval result.
ACCESS_BLOCKED systems remain in the ledger and cannot be silently omitted from the generality discussion.
